name: RxSight, Inc.
summary: RxSight, Inc., a commercial-stage medical technology company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of light adjustable intraocular lenses (LAL) used in cataract surgery in the United States. It offers RxSight system that enables doctors to customize and enhance the visual acuity for patients after cataract surgery.
